title: Mr. D's signal discovery for locating UAP; government radar saw them but did not tell Skywatcher
summary: James Valor tells of Mr. D's signal discovery for locating UAP; government radar saw them but did not tell Skywatcher, about 2021-2025 at Skywatcher operations (unspecified), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And Mr. D. found out, what can we do to pick up signals from these devices, to determine their geolocation or direction in the sky, and

plain: James Valor, from Skywatcher, a startup that says it tries to call up and track UFOs, says a colleague known only as Mr. D worked out how to pick up signals from these objects, which officials now call UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena, so the team could tell where they were in the sky. Valor also says that, sometime between 2021 and 2025, government radar saw the same objects but did not tell Skywatcher. If true, it would mean these objects can be found on purpose, and that the government knew more than it shared.
